recent_news.headline: Salad and Go files for Chapter 11 after cyclospora fears worsened its challenges
recent_news.summary: Fast-casual restaurant chain Salad and Go filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy amid food safety concerns. Health and safety incidents affect restaurant operations and compliance requirements.

recent_news.headline: WRM Officially Closed on Dar Pro's Trap Grease Collection Assets
recent_news.source: McDonald Farms Inc. / Silver City Processing
recent_news.summary: WRM closed on acquisition of Darling Ingredients' trap grease collection and processing assets from Dar Pro Solutions, adding equipment, service routes, and infrastructure across multiple regions to divert grease from water systems.

backfill_news.headline: WEFTEC 2026 Conference Set for September in New Orleans
backfill_news.summary: WEFTEC 2026, the Water Environment Federation's Technical Exhibition and Conference, is scheduled for September 26-30, 2026 at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans. The event will feature 950+ exhibitors, 125+ technical sessions, and immersive hubs covering water quality solutions and innovations.
